summary: Procure HackerRank enterprise assessment seats and complete SCIM/SSO onboarding for Talent Ops
description:
Issue summary: Talent Operations requests purchase of HackerRank (or equivalent) enterprise coding assessment seats to centralize pre-hire technical screenings. Impact: Hiring velocity for SWE/ML roles reduced due to current ad-hoc assessment setup across teams; central license is expected to speed up screening, provide consistent reporting, and reduce per-interview costs.

Request details:
- Product: HackerRank for Work (enterprise) - coding assessments and proctoring add-on
- Seats requested: 150 active candidate assessment credits + 10 admin licenses
- Integrations required: SAML SSO via Okta, SCIM group provisioning for Talent Ops and Interviewer groups, ATS integration (Greenhouse) planning required
- Contract term: 12 months with auto-renew off by default
- Budget code: ENG-HR-2026-Q2 (provided by Talent Ops)

Justification:
- Current practice: individual teams purchase spot credits or use free tools resulting in inconsistent candidate experience and duplicate spend.
- Centralized procurement should reduce duplicate spend by ~30% (estimate from Talent Ops), provide audit trail, and enable compliance checks.

Security & compliance notes:
- Security needs a data flow diagram and SOC2/ISO audit artifacts from vendor prior to final approval. If vendor requires a DPA, legal should onboard.
- No PII beyond candidate contact info expected; proctoring may capture audio/video — need Security sign-off.

Acceptance criteria / success metrics:
- Contract signed and PO issued within approved budget 
- Okta SAML + SCIM configured; test user provisioning and group sync completed in staging 
- Greenhouse integration configured and sample candidate assessment created
- Admin training session scheduled with Talent Ops

Attachments and references:
- Talent Ops ask email (attached in Jira ticket)
- Cost worksheet: https://confluence.internal.redwood.com/display/HR/Assessment+Vendor+Cost+Model

Next steps requested by requester:
1) Procurement to obtain formal quotes from HackerRank and one alternate vendor for comparison.
2) Security to request SOC2 and proctoring data protection notes.
3) IT to provision test Okta SAML app and SCIM mappings for staging environment.
4) Finance to confirm budget allocation and raise PO once legal approves DPA.
